verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Algolia ships an official MCP server (algolia-mcp) so other agents can call Algolia's tools, and Agent Studio connects an LLM to Algolia's own search/tools — but there is no evidence of Algolia's product consuming or plugging in external MCP servers as a tool source for itself. The axis (this product acting as an MCP client to use others' tools) is plausible for a platform like Algolia given Agent Studio's LLM-tool orchestration, but no such capability is documented.
